description: NaMnO₂ is H-Phase structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with six equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-14°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.41 Å. Mn is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, edges with six equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are four shorter (1.93 Å) and two longer (2.40 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. O is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Mn atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₃Mn₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-50°.
